text:
Liam Z.: hi team — quick onboarding question: where should I post different things so i don't clutter channels? examples: repo access, security approvals, vendor arrival at office, expense receipts, lunch polls, and CI noise. also want to mute low-priority bots but still get pings for mentions.

Carmen (People Ops): welcome Liam! short map: 
- Repo/access requests -> open a ticket in #help (tag IT) or use the repo access form (link pinned in #new-hires).
- Security approvals (e.g., SSO, data access) -> start in #eng-security and CC your manager; security team prefers a thread with the approval template.
- Vendor/office pickup -> post in #people-ops or DM Facilities for same-day; include vendor name and ETA.
- Expenses -> #finance with the expense app (do not post receipts in public threads).
- Lunch/social -> #lunch-plans or #random (polls okay there).

Ishan (IT): For CI and deploy noise: we try to funnel builds and deploys into dedicated channels like #ci-notifications and #eng-releases. If a bot is noisy, ask us to move its webhook to a quieter channel. Use threads for follow-ups on infra issues.

Nia Eng: PR review etiquette: put a short summary + link in the PR and if you need cross-team attention post a single message in #eng-code-reviews with the link. Avoid pasting large logs in public channels; use a gist or artifact link. Reactions are our bread-and-butter: :eyes: for "saw it", :+1: for ok, and :white_check_mark: when done.

Liam Z.: how do i keep spammy bot messages out but still get direct mentions?

Ishan (IT): go to channel > Notification preferences and set "All new messages" to off, keep "Direct messages, mentions & keywords" on. Also add keywords (your name, team name) so you only get notified for those. If you want to filter by bot type, we can configure the bot to post only failures or critical events to main channel and successes to #ci-notifications.

Carmen (People Ops): pro tip: pin the onboarding checklist and forms to #new-hires so you can find them quickly. Also opt into the onboarding workflow by reacting to the welcome message (onboard-bot will DM you the checklist).

security-bot: Access request submitted: user=Liam Z. resource=prod-readers status=pending (see /security-requests)

Nia Eng: for security approvals include this template in your initial post in #eng-security to speed things up: 
```
- who: <your name> and manager
- resource: <repo / bucket / project>
- justification: <short reason>
- duration: <permanent / temp until DATE>
```

Liam Z.: good call — i'll post security request with that template. also who should I ping if a vendor arrives and needs entry right away?

Carmen (People Ops): ping Facilities in #people-ops and DM the office line if it's immediate. For vendors carrying equipment request extra time in the form so security can pre-approve.

deploy-bot: Deployment finished: service=api-gateway env=staging sha=9b1c2a (posted in #eng-releases)

Ishan (IT): last note: create a private channel with just your immediate pod for quick coordination if you want fewer cross-team pings. And use thread replies instead of new messages to keep channels searchable.

Liam Z.: perfect, thanks everyone — i'll file the repo access in #help, security request in #eng-security with the template, and lunch poll in #lunch-plans. joining #new-hires now :wave:"
